name: Legacy Rescue Scan
purpose: Bounded evidence-first diagnosis of an existing public-facing or customer-authorized software system before a larger repair, migration, or rebuild decision.
inputs: public URL or customer-authorized system target
customer description of the observed failure or business pain
optional customer-supplied screenshots, logs, exports, or repository evidence that the customer is authorized to provide
outputs: Rescue Sprint scope proposal when appropriate
credit_policy: 100% of the $299 Legacy Rescue Scan fee may be credited toward an authorized Rescue Sprint started within 14 days of scan delivery.
